text:
ana: Heads-up: release for @redwood-inference/sdk-node failed after typegen regen. Two separate failures: npm 401 mid-publish + semver guard blocking due to dist diff. Opening thread to triage.

ana: ```
$ ./scripts/release --pkg sdk-node
> typegen: regenerated models from openapi v1.46.0 (export order changed)
> build ok
> npm publish packages/sdk-node --access public
npm ERR! code E401
npm ERR! 401 Unauthorized - PUT https://registry.npmjs.org/@redwood-inference/sdk-node
Publish aborted: semver-check failed: non-trivial diff detected, missing changelog fragment for minor bump
```

devops-bot: pipeline publish-sdk job=7205 failed (step=publish): reason="401 + semver-guard" :robot_face:

li: is the diff user-visible? I see reordering + an internal helper rename, looks non-breaking. semver tool is hashing dist so reorder trips it.

corey: auth-wise logs show the CI token rotated during the job (creds-rotation ran). Our publish step does 3 fixed retries with no token refresh. Suggest switch to exp backoff + token refresh before retry.

morgan: short-term unblock: add a tiny changelog fragment explaining non-breaking reorder and re-run with a fresh token. I'll do that now. Long-term: teach the semver validator to normalize typegen output (sort exports, strip internals) before diffing. Filing ticket DEVX-1340.

corey: PR up for publish action: https://git.internal/pr/6999  switches to retryUtil.backoff(max=6, baseMs=300, jitter=true) and calls creds.refresh() on retry. Assigning @li for review.

ana: added fragment at scripts/changelog/fragments/sdk-node-typegen-reorder.md and queued job #7206.

devops-bot: job #7206 queued by nana.

li: reviewed PR #6999, small timeout tweak, LGTM after change.

devops-bot: job #7206 started -> publish step invoked

ana: publish hit a transient 401 on attempt 2 but retry + refresh succeeded. changelog fragment satisfied semver guard. package published as @redwood-inference/sdk-node@0.12.5.

morgan: sampleapp onboarding smoke passed; no repeat of 401 loop. I've opened INF-1341 to add a sampleapp e2e that simulates token rotation to catch this earlier.

corey: merged PR #6999 into main; added unit test that fakes token rotation and asserts refresh+backoff are used.

li: filing RFC DEVX-RFC-58 to propose a typegen-normalizer plugin for the semver diff step. @morgan @corey please review.

ana: closing loop: job #7206 succeeded, PR #6999 merged, INF-1341 and DEVX-RFC-58 filed. Thanks all.

morgan: tagging follow-ups: @li (RFC), @corey (e2e), @ana (changelog docs).
